name: Thangka with the Seventh Bodhisattva
material: Silk and gold thread on silk satin ground, embroidery
summary: In remarkably pristine condition, this embroidery is from a dispersed set that included images of protectors and bodhisattvas. The embroidery technique and pictorial style are Chinese, but the subject matter and the type of devotional hanging called a thangka are associated with Tibetan Buddhism. Hi
